hook: A second Riemann proof claim lands
hookText: A second Riemann proof claim lands

beats.say: Mathematician Alessandro Masullo has a proposed proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis, and Brian Conrad has been looking closely at it for months, giving extensive feedback that is being incorporated.
The hope was to bring Masullo to Stanford for a year to polish the writing, then announce it after running it by enough people.
Instead the announcement came out hurried, with a call for people to quickly check it, formalize it, and fill any small gaps.
